adaptations: permanently obscured targets deferred by scenario
full returned route under common compute budget
geometry: frozen v2 UnifiedGeometry; cold cache; common canonical shortest paths
initial_heading: neutral straight-motion reward until the first simulated move; do not read old suffix as executed heading
predator: current target bounding-box west/east outside column selected by base x relative to box midpoint; y=base y; fixed within one solve
reward_distance: Euclidean distance; min-max normalize over eligible uncovered four-neighbor candidates; zero range -> zero for all
reward_straight: straight=1, 90deg=0.5, reversal=0; first simulated move=0 for all
reward_boundary: (4 - number of uncovered traversable four-neighbors of candidate) / 4
tie_rule: largest floating reward, then lexicographically smallest (x,y); no epsilon or randomness
dead_end_goal: reachable pending target with smallest current free-map BFS distance; tie by (x,y)
update: all actual traversed target cells are credited, including during recovery and return
fallback: exact common v2 old suffix then old-target-order + absolute-y-parity completion, fully timed and audited
candidate_acceptance: complete legal cover+return; resource check; accepted before deadline; strictly shorter than incumbent
development_tuning: same 12 predeclared H/p50 states as v1 development preflight; 20 sec per state/weight; all 192 outcomes saved; never holdout
weight_selection: require a complete core route for all 12 states; minimize map-equal mean core length / independently constructed common-fallback length; ties by omega_s+omega_b then omega_s then omega_b; if no eligible pair, no formal candidate
